site.faq.title: Questions
site.faq.body: Can’t find what you need? Our team answers within one working day.
site.faq.a1: Yes. Photos, checklists and voice notes save on the phone and sync automatically when the signal returns, so rooftops and basements are no problem.
site.faq.a2: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Spanish and French — for the app, voice notes and reports. A technician can speak in one language and the customer can read the report in another.
site.faq.q3: Can AI invent work that was not done?
site.faq.a3: No. The report is drafted only from the photos, checklist answers and voice notes recorded on the job. A manager checks and approves every report before the customer sees it.
site.faq.q4: How does the free trial work?
site.faq.a4: You get {plan} free for {n} days, with no card needed. At the end, pick a plan or stay on Free — your jobs and reports stay safe either way.
site.faq.q5: Can customers see reports without an app?
site.faq.a5: Yes. Customers get a secure link by SMS or WhatsApp that opens in any browser, with photos, the checklist and a PDF to download.
site.pfaq.title: Pricing questions
site.pfaq.body: Still deciding? Our team answers within one working day.
site.pfaq.a1: Pick a plan or move to Free. Your jobs, photos and reports stay safe either way — we never charge without asking.
site.pfaq.a2: Yes. Move up or down at any time from Plan and billing in the app. Your data moves with you.
site.pfaq.q3: What counts as an AI report?
site.pfaq.a3: Each job report that AI drafts counts once, however many times you edit it before sending.
site.pfaq.a4: Pay for 10 months and get 12 — that is 2 months free. Your monthly reports and credits stay the same.
site.pfaq.q5: Which payment methods do you accept?
site.pfaq.a5: Cards everywhere, and UPI in India. Enterprise plans can pay by invoice.
